_comment: Does a semantic validator exist that will answer? The gate's 20-minute wait exists to give one time to reply. With no such validator the wait cannot change anything -- it only guarantees that every clean round finishes red and undelivered, because the workflow job times out at 15 minutes and no same-day re-entry is scheduled (docs/daily_orchestrator_contract.md: SAME_DAY_AUTOMATIC_RECOVERY_TRIGGER_NOT_SCHEDULED).
_note_when_flipping_to_true: Setting expected=true reinstates the wait AND makes a re-entry caller a hard prerequisite: something must invoke drain again after timeout_minutes. As of 2026-08-27 no such caller exists -- the P0-02/P0-04 'independent cron' pattern is staggered GitHub Actions crons (same failure plane), and the external consumer contract is read-only (retrieval_pointer_only: true), so it has no authority to fire a repository_dispatch. Do not flip this without naming the caller.
_note_no_new_cron: Adding a cron to manufacture re-entry was deliberately rejected upstream; see docs/daily_orchestrator_contract.md. This config does not add one.
